viewing_check: Check the cap hallmarks (sterling lion/anchor/Sheffield date letter vs EPNS or plain plate), the Dixon mark on the cap or base, size, dents, glass chips or cracks, and leather condition. Hallmarked sterling is worth considerably more than plate. The ivory/bone handle piece is broken and filler only.
